create_relative_interval_bounds: create RelativeIntervalBounds with lower offset, upper offset, and nominal tensors for relative bound propagation
propagate_bounds_through_linear: propagate interval bounds through a linear layer using apply_linear with weights and biases
propagate_bounds_through_conv1d: propagate interval bounds through a 1D convolution layer using apply_conv1d with kernel weights and padding
propagate_bounds_through_conv2d: propagate interval bounds through a 2D convolution layer using apply_conv2d with kernel weights and strides
propagate_bounds_through_activation: propagate interval bounds through increasing monotonic activation functions like relu, tanh, and leaky_relu
